title: Idempotency-Key header
description: Value of the Idempotency-Key request header, required on every authenticated write request (all but POST /auth/login and /auth/logout); missing or malformed: 422 validation_failed with details {"Idempotency-Key": [...]}. Any UUID, in either case; the app sends a new UUIDv7 per logical request. The key belongs to the token's owner (user or device). For 24 hours the same key gets the same response (status and body, with an Idempotent-Replayed: true header; only server_time is current) without running the request again; client errors (4xx) are stored too, server errors (5xx) are not. The same key with a different request (method, path, query or body): 422 validation_failed. The same key while its first request is still running: 409 conflict with a Retry-After header (the only 409 that has one), to be retried later with the same key. A key with no stored response 5 minutes after its first request (the request crashed, timed out or its process stopped) is abandoned: the next attempt with it runs the request again. Rules: docs/decisions.md.
